The title indicates that it records the biographical and karmic account (*apadāna*) of the elder Buddhupaṭṭhāka, reflecting the standard Apadāna genre of detailing a monk's past meritorious deeds and spiritual accomplishments under past Buddhas. Furthermore, formulaic stanzas—most prominently within segments §4.4–7.1—are shared with multiple other poems in the Therāpadāna, including the *Saṁghupaṭṭhākattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 182), *Buddhupaṭṭhāyikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 291), *Kaṇikārachattiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 167), *Sattāhapabbajitattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 290), and *Saparivāriyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 146) [DharmaNexus].
